categories_thin: Keasbey: almost no consumer health or personal-care businesses - the district is industrial/logistics (group D, out of scope). Only a few office-type firms (IT, engineering, real-estate/property) could be mapped.

Hopelawn: very small commercial strip along New Brunswick Ave; directory coverage is thin (16 total listings) and several salons/barbers are visible only through booking apps (Booksy, theCut), not directories.

Mental health / therapists: only two behavioral providers surfaced (Mitch Abrams PsyD, Advent Behavioral Clinics). Most area therapists list only on Psychology Today, which was not accessible in this pass.
Med spas and wellness: thin beyond Skin Outspoken and salon skin-care rooms.
Physical therapy: only one clinic (Opticare, Hopelawn) matched the zone; most PT practices nearby are in Woodbridge/Edison proper.
caveats: Main source is an aggregated local directory that mixes current and legacy listings; entries marked 'one directory only' need triage confirmation before outreach.
Many Fords professional offices are single-attorney or single-CPA suites inside 720/786/860 King George Rd (Kings Road Office Center); they are separate firms sharing a building, not one business.

Some directory entries sit at residential-style addresses (e.g., 6 Webb Dr, 77 Hamilton Ave, 21 Pierce St); those were mostly excluded to avoid home addresses. A few kept where the listing is clearly a practice.
Google Maps served a deliberately limited result set from this environment, so map-based coverage is partial; directories and web search were used to fill gaps.

Branded franchise insurance agencies (e.g., a Farmers agency at 386 New Brunswick Ave) and banks were excluded per the brief; that Farmers agency address is listed here only as a note, not as an entry.
data_gaps: Overpass / OpenStreetMap API unreachable (timeouts on overpass-api.de and the kumi mirror) - no OSM cross-check.
Yellow Pages, Manta, Cataloxy, Hub.biz, LocalityBiz, Each.place returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare bot checks from this environment.
Woodbridge Metro Chamber of Commerce searchable member directory not found; the site returned marketing pages instead.
Woodbridge Township official licensed-business list not retrieved - no public business directory located on the township site in this pass.

Phones missing for businesses found only via booking apps or bestprosintown (Pro Hair, Jnshairstudio, Iron & Ivy, Jazzy Nail, Xclusive Styles, Design Hair Salon, Skin Outspoken, House of Melia, Jiva Hot Yoga, Backsmart).
Fords directory appears to omit some newer businesses (e.g., Iron & Ivy Hair Studio) - a Google Business Profile sweep would add more.
